name: Mickey's Smokestack BBQ Smoked Kielbasa Sausage Link
whyItWorks: Zero plant fiber, but tough natural sausage casing, garlic seasoning, and high emulsified fat can trigger cramping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel away the tough outer casing if tasting in remission, or choose the carved Smoked Beef Brisket (lean flat) or Smoked Chicken instead.
watchOuts: Garlic seasoning and high saturated fat
